verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client and terminal with some AI features, so a conversational coding agent is a fair axis for it. The evidence only shows AI that turns a plain-language description into a single shell command. Nothing documents an agent that browses, searches, edits, commits, pulls or pushes in a repository through conversation, so command generation is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can direct an AI agent to browse, search, edit, commit, pull, and push in a repository via conversation
